title: C4009 — Rear outer parking aid sensor LH connector
introduction:
For the left-hand rear outer parking aid sensor, the component's position matters as much as the connector's shape. I start with the description and harness identity, then match the drawing's cavity labels to the table. Think of the Function column as the address on the parking sensor's mail: it distinguishes the position-specific sensor circuit from the control-module connections.

Read each row across for its circuit identifier, color code, gauge entry and terminal reference. This is an identification map and parts reference. Physical viewing direction, access, probing setup, expected readings and repair methods require the matching workshop procedure. The Gauge convention and Size code are not defined here; reference flags do not establish electrical health.
